name: where-used-rust
ground_truth_source: hand-adjudicated: every whole-word grep hit of the name under crates/ read for its receiver's static type, or for the function a path or bare call resolves to; per-hit decisions in ground_truth/whereused-rust.review.md
selection: Written before any candidate's callers were read. Candidates are under crates/*/src/, outside #[cfg(test)] modules and build.rs: (1) methods with a self receiver declared in a trait defined in the repository (with or without a default body), the target being Trait::method; (2) methods with a self receiver in an inherent impl, the target being Type::method; (3) free functions (a module-level fn, not main), the target being module::function. Left out: associated functions without a self receiver, because Type::f( names the type at every call from outside the impl, as CLASS-METHODS do in B1A; methods in impls of traits defined outside the repository (fmt, from, default, drop, next, ...), whose calls are operators, macros and std code; and the methods of an impl of a repository trait, which belong to that trait's candidate (1). Each must meet (a): the name is declared (fn name, any kind, in any .rs file of the repository, tests and examples included) 3 or more times; and have 6 to 80 call-shaped grep hits (lines of crates/**/*.rs matching \bname\s*\(, which covers .name(, ::name( and a bare name(, case-sensitive, minus lines whose only match is the declaration fn name() in 3 or more files. Strata, assigned in this order: trait (b), a method of a repository trait that 3 or more impl blocks in the repository implement, the question being callers of the trait method (every call that resolves to Trait::method, whatever type implements it: through dyn Trait, a generic or impl Trait bound, a concrete type whose method comes from its impl of the trait, Trait::method(x) or <T as Trait>::method(x), and self.method( ) inside a default body or an impl; an inherent method of the same name on the concrete type is a different function); short (d), a name under 8 characters; polluted (c), whole-word grep hits (\bname\b, crates/**/*.rs, case-sensitive) at least twice its call-shaped hits (the name is also a field, variable, string, enum variant or another item); multi, the remaining candidates. Quota 3 per stratum. Candidates in (file path, line) order, n candidates, k = n div 3, picks at index 0, k, 2k; an index already used, or a name already picked, moves to the next index. Post-check, the only use of callers: a pick is kept only with 3 to 40 true calling functions and true call sites at most 75% of its call-shaped grep hits; otherwise the next index of the same stratum is tried. A stratum that runs out hands each remaining pick, round robin, to the other strata in the order trait, short, polluted, multi, skipping a stratum that has run out, at the index after the last one that stratum tried. Callers anywhere under crates/ count: #[cfg(test)] modules, tests/, benches/ and examples/ included. A call is a call expression written in the source, including one inside a macro's arguments (assert!, format!, vec!); a function named as a value without a call (.map(Type::method)) and a call produced only by a macro's expansion do not count. A true calling function is a distinct (file, innermost enclosing named fn) pair; a closure belongs to the fn it is written in. dimensions lists every one of (a) to (d) a target meets. grep_hits and grep_files are the whole-word baseline, grep_call_* the call-shaped one, true_* the ground truth.

tasks.count_rule: Lang::lower is a trait method; count every call that resolves to it, whatever type implements Lang: through dyn Lang, a generic or impl Lang bound, a concrete type whose lower comes from its impl of Lang, Lang::lower(x) or <T as Lang>::lower(x), and self.lower( ) inside an impl of Lang. An inherent method or a free function of the same name is a different function, also when it is called from inside an impl of Lang.

An inherent method or a free function of the same name is a different function, also when it is called from inside an impl of Lang.

SemanticParserPlugin::extract_entities_with_tree is a trait method; count every call that resolves to it, whatever type implements SemanticParserPlugin: through dyn SemanticParserPlugin, a generic or impl SemanticParserPlugin bound, a concrete type whose extract_entities_with_tree comes from its impl of SemanticParserPlugin, SemanticParserPlugin::extract_entities_with_tree(x) or <T as SemanticParserPlugin>::extract_entities_with_tree(x), and self.extract_entities_with_tree( ) inside an impl of SemanticParserPlugin. An inherent method or a free function of the same name is a different function, also when it is called from inside an impl of SemanticParserPlugin.

arch_view::names is a free function in crates/sem-cli/src/commands/arch_view.rs; count a call that resolves to it: a bare names( ) where it is in scope, or a path to it (arch_view::names( ), crate::...::names( )). A function of the same name in another module, a local helper or a closure bound to the name is a different function.

Another type with the same name in another module is a different type.
